description: This Java source file defines the class `WeightPackageServices` which provides a set of static service methods to manage weight and dimension information for shipping packages within the OFBiz framework. The methods include setting package info, updating, deleting, finalizing packages, and completing shipments, interacting with session objects and the entity model.

classes.name: WeightPackageServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling operations related to weight and dimension management of shipping packages within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets package information such as weight, dimensions, and box type, with validation to prevent conflicting inputs and ensure weight is positive. It updates the session object accordingly and verifies that total packed lines do not exceed ordered quantity.

methods.name: updatePackedLine
methods.description: Updates the details of a specific packed package line, including weight, dimensions, and box type, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: deletePackedLine
methods.description: Removes a specific package line from the session by its sequence ID.

methods.name: completePackage
methods.description: Finalizes the current packaging process by setting UOMs, shipment, invoice info, and costs; then completes the package process, with error handling for shipping quote retrieval and item status.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Completes the shipment process for the order, setting necessary shipment details, and handling errors related to shipment completion.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Saves the package information for an order, primarily related to shipping details, within the session context.
